headings.usage: Use for all main H1-H3 headings. Gives the app a human, editorial, professional consultant feel. Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk. Always use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for large headers.

body.usage: Use for all paragraphs, labels, small text, and UI controls. Provides clean, geometric contrast against the classic serif headings.

colors.description: Like a high-end ceramic studio or a boutique law firm. Warm, trustworthy, extremely minimal.

borders.style: 1px solid #E6E4E0. Ensure crisp edges to ground the soft shadows.

overlays.glass: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-b border-black/5. CRITICAL: Never use pure transparent backgrounds for overlapping content.

layouts.alignment: Left-aligned layouts for forms, text, and dense content. Avoid center-everything disease.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-8 or p-12 for main cards. Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-8) to prevent text collision.

grid.bento_rules: Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 with wide gaps (gap-8).
grid.booking_page: Mobile-first structure. Left-aligned host info card on desktop, with a vertically scrolling list of available days (not a generic grid calendar) on the right.

buttons.primary: Solid dark (#292725), rounded-full or rounded-xl, crisp edges. Hover states must have a slight lift (-translate-y-0.5) and shadow.
buttons.secondary: Outline button with #E6E4E0 border, text #292725, transparent background. Hover: bg-#F4F2EE.

inputs.style: Shadcn standard but customized to remove default blue rings. Use border-[#E6E4E0] with focus:ring-[#8C7A6B]. Background #FFFFFF.

calendar.style: Shadcn calendar. Remove harsh borders. Use soft rounded-lg corners for selected dates with #292725 background.

cards.booking_slot: Flat background (#FFFFFF), 1px subtle border (#E6E4E0), text-left. Hover: border-[#8C7A6B] bg-[#F4F2EE].

dialogs.style: Shadcn dialog. Use #FFFFFF surface with heavy ambient shadow. Backdrop must be bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-sm.

motion.hover_states: All interactive elements need micro-animations. transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for booking slots in the list.
motion.constraints: Exclude transforms from universal transitions (transition: all). Use specific properties.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text. Use APCA contrast guidelines. Text over buttons must be #FFFFFF.
accessibility.focus: All focusable elements must have visible focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#8C7A6B] focus:outline-none).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-form-submit-button', data-testid='booking-slot-10am').

images.description: Warm minimal workspace for login/signup split-screen background.
Intricate sandy earth texture for subtle section backgrounds or empty states.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Generate pure JavaScript (.jsx/.js) files, absolutely NO TypeScript (.tsx/.ts).
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Do NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned). Left-align reading content naturally.
Do NOT use HTML-based components for advanced interactions. Use Shadcn for Select, Dialog, Calendar.
Include data-testid on every button, link, and form input.
Never use purely transparent backgrounds on headers or sticky elements; always use backdrop-blur and semi-transparent colors.
